gaps.concept: The nipple is supplied mainly by the fourth intercostal nerve (T4 dermatome).
gaps.why_tested: A stem asks for the nerve or dermatome supplying nipple sensation. [Anatomic study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8785595/)

gaps.concept: Failure of embryonic milk-line regression can produce an accessory nipple (polythelia) or accessory breast tissue (polymastia).
gaps.why_tested: A patient has an extra nipple or breast tissue between the axilla and groin. [Embryology reference](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3706049/)

gaps.concept: Tumor obstruction of dermal lymphatics causes breast edema and peau d’orange.
gaps.why_tested: A stem asks why breast skin is swollen and orange-peel textured. [Histologic study](https://repository.up.ac.za/handle/2263/19630)

gaps.concept: The upper outer quadrant is the most frequent site of breast carcinoma.
gaps.why_tested: A question asks which breast quadrant most often contains a primary tumor. [Tumor-location study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15767185/)

gaps.concept: Breast lymph commonly passes from pectoral axillary nodes to central nodes, then apical nodes.
gaps.why_tested: A stem asks which node group receives drainage after the anterior axillary nodes. [Anatomy reference](https://medicine.uams.edu/neuroscience/education/medical-school-courses/human-structure-module/anatomy-tables/lymphatic-tables/lymphatics-of-the-thorax/)

gaps.concept: A nonlactating breast has sparse alveoli and abundant stroma and fat; lactation produces prominent secretory alveoli with enlarged lumina.
gaps.why_tested: A histology image must be identified as lactating or nonlactating breast. [Histology reference](https://tales.nmc.unibas.ch/en/histology-12/fortpflanzungsorgane-weiblich-anatomische-mikroskopie-46/lactating-breast-tissue-1853)

gaps.concept: Mammary epithelial cells release milk proteins by merocrine exocytosis and milk lipids by apocrine secretion.
gaps.why_tested: A micrograph shows apical cytoplasm budding into a milk-filled alveolus. [Histology reference](https://tales.nmc.unibas.ch/en/histology-12/fortpflanzungsorgane-weiblich-anatomische-mikroskopie-46/lactating-breast-tissue-1853)

gaps.concept: Intralobular stroma is loose connective tissue; interlobular stroma is denser and contains more collagen and fat.
gaps.why_tested: A breast histology section asks which stromal compartment surrounds the acini. [Microscopic anatomy reference](https://screening.iarc.fr/atlasbreastdetail.php?Index=005)

gaps.concept: The nipple has keratinized stratified squamous epithelium, continuous with the duct openings’ squamous lining.
gaps.why_tested: A nipple biopsy asks for its normal surface epithelium or the epithelial transition at a duct opening. [Histology reference](https://blogs.gwu.edu/smhs-histology/mammary-gland/)
